name: What is the best type of flooring to install over a basement concrete slab?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of flooring to install over a basement concrete slab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) and engineered tile are widely considered the most practical flooring choices for below-grade concrete slabs. Unlike traditional solid hardwood, which expands and buckles when exposed to concrete moisture transmission, vinyl plank is waterproof, dimensionally stable, and resistant to temperature shifts. If you prefer carpet for comfort and warmth, using an approved moisture-resistant synthetic subfloor panel underneath prevents dampness from reaching the carpet pad. Concrete leveling is often required prior to laying any rigid flooring to prevent uneven seams.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterproof luxury vinyl plank and engineered tile are best because they tolerate subfloor moisture and temperature shifts. Solid hardwood should be avoided directly over concrete slabs.
